about: A2UI eval for show_ui (AUTO-104). Each task is one user message in a phone chat. 'expect' is checked on the first valid show_ui stream: components (each entry a type or 'A|B'), minInputs, inputsBound (every input's value is a {"@path"}), actionUsesInputs (a Button's event context, or sendDataModel, carries every bound input), action (a Button with an action), checks (at least N components with checks), checkFunctions (functions the checks must use, 'a|b' for either), template (a ChildList template over an array of 2+ items in the data model), props (a component of that type whose prop equals a value or has minItems). noUi tasks pass when the model answers in text without show_ui.

tasks.prompt: Can you help me book a haircut tomorrow? The free slots are 9:00, 10:30, 13:00, 15:30 and 17:00. Let me pick one.
Sam invited me to dinner on Saturday. Ask me whether I'm coming and how many guests I'm bringing.
Quick RSVP for the team offsite next Friday: yes, no or maybe. Show them as chips and a send button.
Sign me up for the newsletter. Ask for my name and email; both are required and the email has to be a valid address.
I want to change my password. Ask for the current one and a new one; the new password must be at least 8 characters. Hide what I type.
Show my notification settings so I can change them: email alerts are on, push notifications are off, the weekly digest is on. Add a save button.
Set the living room temperature. It's 21 degrees now and it can go from 16 to 28.
I'm ordering a pizza. Let me choose my toppings: mushrooms, olives, pepperoni, peppers, onions, extra cheese. I can pick as many as I want.
Where should we eat tonight? Give me chips for Thai, Italian, Mexican, Japanese and Indian.

Here are hotels near the station: Hotel Aster (120 EUR, 4.5 stars), Ibis Central (85 EUR, 4.0), The Linden (160 EUR, 4.7), Parkview Inn (95 EUR, 3.9). Show them as a list built from data, with a button on each to pick it.
Show my recent contacts as a list from data with a call button on each: Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev and Ema.
Show my to-do list with a checkbox on each item: buy milk, pay rent, call mom, book flights. Use a template over the items.
I want to book a flight to Lisbon. Ask me for the departure date and the return date.
Remind me to call the dentist. Let me pick the date and the time.
Ask for my date of birth to finish setting up my profile.
Help me plan a weekend trip in steps, one tab each: 1. destination, 2. dates, 3. budget. Then a button to plan it.
Show the pancake recipe with two tabs, Ingredients and Steps. Ingredients: 200 g flour, 2 eggs, 300 ml milk, a pinch of salt. Steps: whisk everything, rest 10 minutes, fry in a hot pan.
Set up my account in two tabs: Profile (name, required) and Preferences (dark mode on or off, language). One button at the end to finish.
Summarize my coffee order in a card: 2 oat lattes, 1 croissant, total 11.40 EUR, pickup at 8:15. Add a button to confirm it.
Show the weather for Berlin as a card: 14 degrees, light rain, wind 12 km/h, with a button to see the hourly forecast.
Show the apartment listing as a card with its photo (https://example.com/flat.jpg), the rent of 1,250 EUR a month and a 'Request a viewing' button.
I want to delete my 3 old backups. Show a delete button that opens a confirmation first.
Ask me to rate the app from 1 to 5 and leave an optional comment.
I want to report a bug: a title (required), a description, and the severity: low, medium or high.
Collect my shipping address: street, city, postal code (exactly 5 digits) and country. All fields are required.
Help me split an 84 EUR dinner bill: let me enter the number of people and the tip percentage.
Which of these times work for you for next week's sync: Mon 10:00, Tue 14:00, Wed 9:30, Thu 16:00? Let me pick all that work.
Change the app language. Options: English, Deutsch, Francais, Espanol, Italiano.
Show me the plans and let me pick one: Free (1 device), Plus at 4 EUR a month (5 devices), Pro at 9 EUR a month (unlimited devices).
Log today's run: distance in km (required), duration in minutes, and how it felt: easy, ok or hard.
Book a table at Nora's: the date, the time, the party size (1 to 8) and a name for the booking. The name is required.
What's 15% of 80?
Tell me one fun fact about octopuses.
